characters.name: Commander Kaelen
characters.locked_description: Human male, early 40s, 185cm tall, weathered jawline with tactical stubble and a faint silver cybernetic ocular graft over his left eye. Broad athletic build. Wearing a matte-charcoal modular ballistic duster coat with reinforced obsidian-fiber collar, magnetic gear clasps across the chest, and distressed leather combat gloves. Proportions are grounded, muscular and heroic.

voice.tone: Low resonant baritone, quiet grit, contemplative and authoritative.

characters.reference_sheet_prompt: Character model sheet of Commander Kaelen, front view, 45 degree angle side view, and back view. 4 distinct facial expressions (stoic focus, grim realization, determined command, subtle empathy). Neutral gray studio backdrop, sharp studio key lighting.

locations.name: The Sub-Surface Transit Terminus
locations.locked_description: Massive subterranean high-speed maglev platform carved from brutalist obsidian basalt and frosted structural glass. Wet reflective polished floor reflecting cyan neon signage and amber signal lamps. Heavy industrial atmospheric mist venting from ceiling grilles, damp condensation on structural pillars.
locations.reference_prompt: Wide architectural establishing shot of The Sub-Surface Transit Terminus. Obsidian pillars, frosted glass walkways, cyan and amber neon reflections, humid mist.

locations.name: The High Observatory Sanctuary
locations.locked_description: Grand domed panoramic observation chamber perched over the endless cloud sea. Curved brass astrolabe ribs framing reinforced quartz observation windows. Heavy oak holographic terminal table in the center casting cool cerulean light across ancient star charts.
locations.reference_prompt: Wide interior shot of The High Observatory Sanctuary, domed ceiling, golden astrolabe framework, cool blue holographic starmap.

locations.name: سوق الزقاق النبضي المغمور (The Submerged Pulse Bazaar)
locations.locked_description: Multi-tiered subterranean marketplace suspended beneath massive hydraulic floodgates in Sector 7. Dense labyrinth of corrugated sheet metal stalls with fluorescent holographic awnings glowing in intense magenta and viridian emerald through thick swirling steam from open drainage grates. Worn hexagonal basalt pavers slick with iridescent oily rainwater. Overhead tangled networks of heavy industrial cabling, dangling crimson paper lanterns, and humming electrical transformers. Merchant stalls display glowing jars of bio-luminescent algae, copper cooling heat sinks, and sizzling street noodle woks.
locations.reference_prompt: Wide atmospheric architectural establishing shot of The Submerged Pulse Bazaar, tiered subterranean alleyways, neon magenta and emerald light cutting through humid sewer steam, wet reflective basalt ground, dense aerial power cables, 35mm cinematic film still.

locations.name: خزنة الأرشيف السيليكوني المتجمدة (The Apex Cryo-Silicon Vault)
locations.locked_description: Monolithic subterranean data sanctuary kept at sub-zero cryogenic temperatures with visible creeping plumes of white vapor across mirror-polished black obsidian flooring. Colossal four-story cylindrical towers of liquid-nitrogen-cooled glass server columns pulsing with rhythmic amber optical data nodes. Brutalist vaulted ceiling with exposed brushed-titanium load trusses. In the chamber center sits an elevated circular quartz terminal pedestal with a floating amber volumetric starmap. Floating silent surveillance drones with blue lens apertures hover motionless in the frigid mist.
locations.reference_prompt: Grand architectural interior establishing shot of The Apex Cryo-Silicon Vault, towering vertical glass server monoliths pulsing amber light, swirling sub-zero fog over mirror-finish obsidian floor, cold teal and amber lighting, high cinematic symmetry, 8k resolution.

scenes.summary: الوصول إلى رصيف قطار الماغليف تحت المطر المستمر وبدء تعقب الإشارة.
scenes.narration_text: قطارات الماغليف في هذا القطاع لا تهدأ أبداً. حتى في ساعات الحظر، تتساقط قطرات الماء المتكثف من الأقواس الحجرية العالية، كأنها عدّ تنازلي لنهاية صامتة. تفقّد كايزن ياقة معطفه الواقي؛ هنا عند حافة المحطة القديمة، لا أحد يسأل عن وجهتك، وكل وجه يروي حكاية محاولة نسيان لماضٍ لم يعد مسجلاً في أي أرشيف رسمي.
scenes.emotional_beat: عزلة قاسية وترقب حذر مع إيقاع السرد البطيء

scenes.summary: اللقاء السري مع إيلينا بجوار المحول الكهربائي وفك شفرة الكبسولة البرونزية.
scenes.narration_text: لم تلتفت إيلينا حين اقترب كايزن. كانت أصابعها تتحرك بسرعة خافتة عبر لوحة البيانات المضيئة. 'أغلقوا مسارات الشمال قبل نصف ساعة،' قالت بصوت متزن رغم ارتعاش خطوط الضغط الكهربائي خلفها. رفعت أسطوانة الذاكرة النحاسية المشفرة؛ كانت شاشتها تنبض بإحداثيات محذوفة من كل الخرائط المصرح بها. 'ما تبقى من الحقيقة لا يملك وقتاً للانتظار.'
scenes.emotional_beat: توتر متبادل وثقة حذرة في مواجهة المجهول

scenes.summary: الصعود بالمصعد الهوائي نحو المرصد واختراق الغيوم لرؤية النبض الضوئي.
scenes.narration_text: ارتجف المصعد النحاسي وهو يخترق طبقة العواصف الكثيفة، منبثقاً فجأة في سكون الغسق الفضي الصافي. وفوقهما، عبر قبة الكوارتز الشاهقة، لم تكن السماء فارغة. دوامة من الضوء الأيوني كانت تلتف ببطء نحو البرج المداري الأخير. أدرك كايزن للمرة الأولى في مسيرته الطويلة أن بعض الألغاز لا تحتاج إلى سلاح لحلها، بل تحتاج إلى شهود على الحقيقة.
scenes.emotional_beat: رهبة واكتشاف مهيب يختتم المرحلة التمهيدية للفيلم

scenes.summary: Commander Kaelen arrives at the deserted Sub-Surface Transit Terminus, investigating a sudden blackout in the regional transit grid.
scenes.narration_text: The lowest levels of the metropolis never truly sleep, yet tonight the Sub-Surface Terminus feels hollowed out, drained of life. Mist hangs cold and dense over the wet basalt tiles, catching the dying pulse of cyan neon signage like fractured glass. Kaelen scans the silent maglev tracks. Residual static hums along the guide rails, but the transit boards have been wiped clean. No manifests, no maintenance alerts, no incoming trains. He tightens his ballistic duster against the industrial draft, calibrating his cybernetic ocular graft to cut through the condensation. Someone deliberately pulled this platform off the central network less than thirty minutes ago. In a city driven by endless data streams, complete silence is never a malfunction—it is a calculated prelude.

scenes.summary: Dr. Elena Vasquez rendezvouses with Kaelen to deliver decrypted atmospheric telemetry tracing an anomaly to the upper atmosphere.
scenes.narration_text: A pneumatic hiss cuts through the silence as Dr. Elena Vasquez steps from the shadows of a structural pillar, her surveyor suit glistening with condensation. 'You shouldn't have come alone, Kaelen,' she whispers, activating her holoscreen gauntlet. Warm amber light flickers between them as dense telemetry cascades into view. 'The station wasn't shut down by local authorities. The command came from above the cloud deck.' Kaelen leans in, his synthetic eye tracing the anomalous data spikes. 'The High Observatory?' Elena nods, her jaw set with quiet urgency. 'An unregistered carrier signal hijacked the regional relay at midnight. If that data stream synchronizes with the municipal power grid, the entire sector will be scrubbed from the archives. We need physical access to their core terminal, now.'

scenes.summary: Kaelen and Elena breach the High Observatory Sanctuary and activate the primary terminal, uncovering a catastrophic coordinate lock.
scenes.narration_text: Thousands of meters above the toxic smog, the High Observatory Sanctuary rests in chilling stillness. Endless banks of silver clouds roll outside the curved quartz windows, framed by massive brass astrolabe arches. Elena reaches the heavy oak table and drives her bypass key into the interface slot. Instantly, the terminal ignites, casting brilliant cerulean light across their faces as a spherical holographic starmap blooms outward. But these are not celestial routes. Dense orbital firing vectors intersect with the city's power grid below, pulsing in synchronous crimson rings. Kaelen watches the countdown timer dwindle on the glass display, his voice dropping to a grim whisper. 'This isn't an observatory archive, Elena. It's a targeting terminal. And we are standing inside the trigger.'
